name: mcp-commander-analysis
description: Vision, OCR, VLM, and knowledge tools for CAD design analysis. Provides image understanding, text extraction, and engineering knowledge lookup.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Analyze a CAD screenshot or design image using vision AI

tools.name: detect_features
tools.description: Detect CAD features and geometry in a design image

tools.name: compare_designs
tools.description: Compare two designs and highlight differences

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Extract text from drawings, blueprints, or screenshots via OCR

tools.name: extract_dimensions
tools.description: Extract dimension values from engineering drawings

tools.name: lookup_material
tools.description: Look up material properties and specifications from engineering databases

tools.name: lookup_standard
tools.description: Look up design standards (ISO, ASME, ANSI) for compliance checks

tools.name: validate_geometry
tools.description: Validate CAD geometry for manufacturability and design rule compliance
